title: bromus pratensis var. simplex
intro: Bromus pratensis var. simplex, commonly known as meadow brome, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of meadow brome include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it a useful remedy for treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of meadow brome include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
